newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha Sept swaps up $2 on crude, Oct up $3.50.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha Sept swaps up $2 on crude, Oct up $3.50.

text.p: The NWE naphtha market was firmer on Tuesday on the back of strong crude futures gains on the IPE and NYMEX, dealers said.
Swaps values for September rose by around $2 to $186.50-$187.50 amid numerous trades that brokers said had been done on a private and confidential basis.
October moved into slight contango to September at $187.50-$188, $3-$3.50 up on the day as November and December were also seen edging into contango over previous months.
